en_title: LucasFilm Games Producer Responds after Galactic Racer Character Biddy Blas Goes Viral
cn_title: 卢卡斯影业制作人回应赛车角色走红
subtitle: 把我的名字纹在手臂上
opus_summary: 《星球大战：银河赛车手》角色凭搞笑的自我介绍和配音走红，卢卡斯影业游戏制作人发文感谢玩家的喜爱。开发商还宣布，未来几周的更新将把多人组队人数上限翻倍。

paragraphs.en: If you’ve been on gaming Twitter recently, you’ve probably seen a clip from Star Wars: Galactic Racer making the rounds on your timeline — specifically, a player’s interaction with a character named Biddy Blas.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你最近在X上关注游戏话题，大概已经在动态里刷到过一段广为流传的《星球大战：银河赛车手》片段——具体来说，是一名玩家与名叫Biddy Blas的角色互动的画面。

paragraphs.en: It’s almost impossible to hate the guy, who tells you all about how awesome he is in a hilarious spiel that has somehow become everyone’s new vocal stim. In Huttese, Blas tells you: “Here’s a name for you, amateur! Biddy Blas. Write it down. Tattoo it on your arm, and someday your arm will be worth millions!”
paragraphs.cn: 这家伙实在让人讨厌不起来。他用一段滑稽的长篇大论告诉你自己有多厉害，不知怎么的，这段话就成了大家忍不住反复念叨的新口头禅。Blas用赫特语对你说：「菜鸟，记住这个名字！Biddy Blas。把它写下来。纹在你的手臂上，总有一天，你这条胳膊会价值数百万！」

paragraphs.en: However, it’s the fantastic voice acting behind this line that’s got players cracking up. “Biddy Blas! Scrib doon!” is an undeniable banger, and I personally cannot stop saying it in response to basically anything. (My poor friend group is already tired of it.)
paragraphs.cn: 不过，真正让玩家笑出声的，是这句台词精彩的配音。「Biddy Blas！Scrib doon！」绝对是句金句，我现在基本上听到什么都忍不住用它来回应。（我那群可怜的朋友已经听腻了。）

paragraphs.en: This Star Wars: Galactic Racer voice acting though! 💀🤣 https://t.co/oYkTMT2nSf
paragraphs.cn: 《星球大战：银河赛车手》这配音也太逗了！💀🤣 https://t.co/oYkTMT2nSf

paragraphs.en: Posts of Blas introducing himself have gone viral on social media, to the point where they caught the attention of LucasFilm Games Producer Craig Derrick, who responded to the overwhelming influx of love for Blas on Twitter/X.
paragraphs.cn: Blas自我介绍的相关帖子在社交媒体上疯传，甚至引起了卢卡斯影业游戏制作人Craig Derrick的注意。他在X上发文，回应了大家对Blas涌来的喜爱。

paragraphs.en: “It’s amazing to see so many people loving Galactic Racer!” he wrote. “Thank you for all the kind words! Every one of my social feeds is filled with posts about the game… while the algorithm continues to properly prioritize Mister Biddy Blas. I love it.”
paragraphs.cn: 他写道：「看到这么多人喜欢《星球大战：银河赛车手》，真是太棒了！感谢大家的赞美！我所有社交平台的动态都被这款游戏的帖子刷屏了……而算法也一直很懂事地优先推荐Biddy Blas先生。我太喜欢了。」

paragraphs.en: Biddy Blas is a Crocin who, as players have come to find out, will literally do whatever it takes to win… even if that means giving you a ‘gift’ that’s actually a bomb, which, if you accept it, will explode your ship and give your opponents a major head start.
paragraphs.cn: Biddy Blas是一名Crocin族角色，玩家逐渐发现，他为了赢真的会不择手段……哪怕是送你一份其实是炸弹的「礼物」。一旦收下，你的飞船就会被炸毁，对手也会因此在起跑时大幅领先。

paragraphs.en: It’s amazing to see so many people loving Galactic Racer! Thank you for all the kind words! 🙏
paragraphs.cn: 看到这么多人喜欢《星球大战：银河赛车手》，真是太棒了！感谢大家的赞美！🙏

paragraphs.en: Every one of my social feeds is filled with posts about the game… while the algorithm continues to properly prioritize Mister Biddy Blas. I love it. 😂 https://t.co/SdXjIq9HkF
paragraphs.cn: 我所有社交平台的动态都被这款游戏的帖子刷屏了……而算法也一直很懂事地优先推荐Biddy Blas先生。我太喜欢了。😂 https://t.co/SdXjIq9HkF

paragraphs.en: Hate him or love him, the guy’s the talk of the town right now, with some fans affectionately dubbing him the “glup shitto of the year.”
paragraphs.cn: 不管你喜欢还是讨厌他，这家伙现在都是大家热议的对象，一些粉丝还亲切地称他为「年度glup shitto」。

paragraphs.en: “I would like to say I'd die for Biddy Blas, but at the same time, I have also slammed him into a wall at like 500mph multiple times at this stage,” one fan joked .
paragraphs.cn: 一位粉丝开玩笑说：「我很想说，我愿意为Biddy Blas赴死，但话说回来，玩到现在，我也已经好几次以大约每小时500英里（约合每小时805公里）的速度把他撞到墙上了。」

paragraphs.en: “Biddy Blas is hilarious, I'm going to kill him,” another said after their speeder got blown up thanks to accepting Blas’s ‘gift.’
paragraphs.cn: 另一位玩家收下Blas的「礼物」、导致自己的飞行摩托被炸毁后说道：「Biddy Blas太搞笑了，我要宰了他。」

paragraphs.en: Star Wars: Galactic Racer has been a major hit with Star Wars fans and critics alike, with IGN’s Luke Reilly scoring the game an eight out of ten. “Star Wars: Galactic Racer is a fabulous looking and frantically fast anti-grav racer that gets a little repetitive thanks to its heavy reliance on repeatedly revisiting the same slim selection of planets, but has successfully lit the afterburners on a long-dormant slice of the Star Wars universe,” he wrote in our review .
paragraphs.cn: 《星球大战：银河赛车手》深受《星球大战》粉丝和评论界喜爱，IGN的Luke Reilly给出了8分的评价，满分10分。他在评测中写道：「《星球大战：银河赛车手》是一款画面出众、速度快得惊人的反重力竞速游戏。由于游戏很大程度上依赖玩家反复重访同样的少数几颗星球，玩起来有些重复，但它成功为《星球大战》宇宙中沉寂已久的一部分点燃了加力燃烧室。」

paragraphs.en: It’s a good time to be a pod racer, as developer Fuse Games recently announced that Galactic Racer’s multiplayer party limit will soon double in size in a post-launch patch coming in the next few weeks.
paragraphs.cn: 对飞梭赛车手来说，现在是个好时候。开发商Fuse Games最近宣布，《星球大战：银河赛车手》将在未来几周推出发售后补丁，把多人组队人数上限翻倍。
